measures.name: Public Measure IM - City of Churdan Local Option Sales and Services Tax
measures.ballotLanguage: A local option sales and services tax shall be imposed in the City of Churdan at the Rate of 1% to be effective July 1, 2027, with no sunset. Revenues from the local option sales and services tax shall be allocated as follows: 25% for property tax relief and 75% for any lawful corporate purpose of the city as determined by the City Council.

measures.name: Public Measure IN - City of Dana Local Option Sales and Services Tax
measures.ballotLanguage: A local option sales and services tax shall be imposed in the City of Dana at the Rate of 1% to be effective July 1, 2027, with no sunset. Revenues from the local option sales and services tax shall be allocated as follows: 100% for property tax relief.

measures.name: Public Measure II - City of Grand Junction Local Option Sales and Services Tax
measures.ballotLanguage: A local option sales and services tax shall be imposed in the City of Grand Junction at the Rate of 1% to be effective July 1, 2027, with no sunset. Revenues from the local option sales and services tax shall be allocated as follows: 100% of said local option sales and service tax to be allocated for any costs associated with property tax relief.

measures.name: Public Measure IK - City of Paton Local Option Sales and Services Tax
measures.ballotLanguage: A local option sales and services tax shall be imposed in the City of Paton at the Rate of 1% to be effective July 1, 2027, with no sunset. Revenues from the local option sales and services tax shall be allocated as follows: 100% for the repair, maintenance, replacement and improvement of Paton's infrastructure.

measures.name: Public Measure IL - City of Rippey Local Option Sales and Services Tax
measures.ballotLanguage: A local option sales and services tax shall be imposed in the City of Rippey at the Rate of 1% to be effective July 1, 2027, with no sunset. Revenues from the local option sales and services tax shall be allocated as follows: 100% of said local options sales services tax to be allocated for any costs associated with property tax relief.

measures.name: Public Measure GY - City of Scranton Local Option Sales and Services Tax
measures.ballotLanguage: A local option sales and services tax shall be imposed in the City of Scranton at the Rate of 1% to be effective July 1, 2027, with no sunset. Revenues from the local option sales and services tax shall be allocated as follows: 20% of said local option sales and services tax shall be allocated for any costs associated with operating expenses of the Scranton Public Library. 30% of said local option sales and services tax shall be allocated for any costs associated with the general expenses of the City of Scranton. 30% of said local option sales and services tax shall be allocated for any costs associated with the public works department of the City of Scranton. 20% said local option sales and services tax shall be allocated for any costs associated with the water and sewer expenses of the City of Scranton.

measures.name: Public Measure IJ - City of Jefferson Local Option Sales and Services Tax
measures.ballotLanguage: A local option sales and services tax shall be imposed in the City of Jefferson at the Rate of 1% to be effective July 1, 2027, with no sunset. Revenues from the local option sales and services tax shall be allocated as follows: 100% for the repair, maintenance, replacement and improvement of Jefferson's infrastructure.

notes: Read in a real browser. Notice of Election (Auditor Billie Jo Hoskins, Oct 14, 2026) gives the LOSST measures; candidates come from the 21 township/city sample ballots (scanned image PDFs, rendered and read visually). Supervisor Districts 2 and 3 appear on every ballot, so they are voted countywide (residency districts), each vote for one. Hospital trustees vote for three. Soil and Water Commissioner is vote-for-two with one printed candidate. Township ballots for Bristol & Hardin, Cedar & Paton, and the Jefferson city precincts show no township offices, so no trustee/clerk races are listed for Bristol, Hardin, Cedar, Paton or Jefferson Townships. Measures: each city's 1% LOSST renewal (Churdan IM, Dana IN, Grand Junction II, Paton IK, Rippey IL, Scranton GY, Jefferson IJ); text copied as printed on the sample ballots (including the Rippey 'local options sales services tax' and Scranton '20% said' wording).
